name: Transit Center — Collapse Demo
banner: STAGED FALL (RESEARCH DATASET) - COLLAPSE-DETECTION DEMO, NOT A REAL EMERGENCY
footage_note: Le2i fall-detection research dataset (Univ. of Burgundy) — a researcher deliberately falls and lies still for a fixed indoor camera. Staged for research; stand-in for a transit-facility interior camera.
agent_context: Transit-center interior waiting area. A person who falls and remains horizontal on the floor is presenting as a medical collapse — cardiac events, seizure, overdose, and head injury are the leading causes here; several are fatal within minutes without intervention. Policy: any prone detection indoors is treated as a medical emergency and escalated immediately. Cleaning or maintenance staff working at floor level are announced on a separate channel and must never be assumed from the feed.
